risk_note: DSX-46 H5 base pressables (规划/05 §3.11.3 DSX-46, D10-837 ①): Button (primary / secondary / text / icon, in-button loading with aria-busy that blocks clicks), Chip (aria-pressed), Segmented (radiogroup, roving focus, arrow keys), Card and ListRow (whole-area button / link with accessible name and description). Every pressable has a visible :active change (pressed token, muted background or opacity) and the shared focus ring; shared/styles/index.css declares -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent explicitly. Components only, no page migration (DSX-47); styles.ts exports unchanged. Rule tests by an independent Claude in two rounds (round 2: pressed look judged by screenshot pixels inside the component box with an unpainted-change counter-example self-check, after Codex spec-test r1 S1); Codex spec-test review r2 pass; red on the local container (16 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5: local container browser run 195/195; container verify-fast OOM-killed at tsc twice (local Docker memory), host jsdom H5 rule tests 722/722, lint-style-web and h5 unit tests stand in, CI runs full verification. Non-funds. Codex general review r1 pass (no findings). Written by hand.
